leftEvidence.title: Jesus is faithful witness, firstborn from the dead, ruler, and coming one

points.label: Visual form
points.left: The opening is an epistolary greeting and announcement.
points.right: The later passage is a throne-room vision with scroll, elders, and song.

points.label: Death and outcome
points.left: Firstborn, blood, release, kingdom, and coming are named.
points.right: Slaughter, blood, purchased peoples, kingdom, and priests are sung.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: A Lamb stands as slain and receives a song about purchase and kingdom

payload.tension: Related titles and blood-language appear in distinct literary scenes and should not be flattened into one image.
payload.title: Firstborn from the dead / standing Lamb as slain
